asks.recommended_answer: The Cauldron is a mineral forest beneath an angry sky of lightning without rain. Acid pools and vent chemistry shape its plants, animals and the people who work there. A lull in vent breathing and nearby animals’ stillness give about an in-game hour of warning before a bloom burdens exposed bodies with metal. Thornwood pays wood and metal for slow, exposed work. Mineral creatures offer food, danger and protective material, while grove-bound rhossak renew the forest and wild vexxiss compete for tapped vents. Connected vent gas carries fire across water with dramatic blasts that throw nearby goods. Shelter, sealed clothing, vexxith protection and Filter-Works support dependable production of fresh water and useful chemicals. Preparation earns manageable daily work and worthwhile industry, with risky expeditions and wildlife still demanding choices. Heavy-metal poisoning persists until advanced medicine purges it, and acid can permanently disfigure and injure sensory organs.

root_proposal.text: The Cauldron is a mineral forest beneath an angry sky of lightning without rain. Acid pools and vent chemistry shape its plants, animals and the people who work there. A lull in vent breathing and nearby animals’ stillness give about an in-game hour of warning before a bloom burdens exposed bodies with metal. Thornwood pays wood and metal for slow, exposed work. Mineral creatures offer food, danger and protective material, while grove-bound rhossak renew the forest and wild vexxiss compete for tapped vents. Connected vent gas carries fire across water with dramatic blasts that throw nearby goods. Shelter, sealed clothing, vexxith protection and Filter-Works support dependable production of fresh water and useful chemicals. Preparation earns manageable daily work and worthwhile industry, with risky expeditions and wildlife still demanding choices. Heavy-metal poisoning persists until advanced medicine purges it, and acid can permanently disfigure and injure sensory organs.
